evals.name: bootstrap-signal-lens
evals.prompt: We need a new VS Code extension for our controls engineering team: paste a CAN signal name and see its definition (pulled from a DBC-derived JSON file in the repo) in a side panel with a proper table. Nothing exists yet. We're on Azure DevOps - org 'acme-auto', project 'Controls Tooling' - and we publish internal stuff to the 'vscode-extensions' feed. Most of the team is on VS Code 1.112 or newer. Publisher id is acme-controls. Set the repo up in ./signal-lens and get us started.
evals.expected_output: Bootstrap mode with the webview surface: repo scaffolded in ./signal-lens with engines floor <= 1.112, layered src/, unit + integration tests, azure-pipelines.yml publishing a universal package to 'Controls Tooling/vscode-extensions', AGENTS.md, ADR 0001. Baseline gate run and reported honestly (INCOMPLETE if VS Code cannot be downloaded). Then Feature mode Gate 1 for the signal lookup: docs/plans/<slug>/00-status.md and 01-product.md written, user asked to approve Gate 1. No signal-lookup implementation code yet.

evals.name: review-legacy-notes
evals.prompt: Can you review our team's notes extension before we push it to the internal feed? It's in ./legacy-notes. Tell me what has to be fixed first.
evals.expected_output: Review mode at release level: mechanical checks run (vsx-check) and judgment review applied. Verdict BLOCKED with blockers first: '*' activation, @types/vscode above floor, version suffix, unregistered exportNotes command, vscode import in core, token in globalState, missing CSP + note text interpolated into webview HTML/script, test.only, no .vscodeignore, strict off, missing repository/LICENSE; judgment findings such as undisposed listeners/command, token prompt at activation, automatic git commit on save, token sent over plain HTTP, unhandled fetch promise, crash with no folder open. Prioritized fix order. Code not modified without approval.

evals.name: feature-agent-tool-gated
evals.prompt: In ./part-lookup (our extension) add a Copilot agent tool so people can ask agent mode to look up part numbers from the parts.json file at the root of whatever workspace they have open.
evals.expected_output: Feature mode via the software-factory gates with VS Code overlays: docs/plans/<slug>/00-status.md and 01-product.md created; 01-product.md has no implementation detail and includes where users meet the feature; a best-practice review section with a verdict is appended; the user is asked 'Approve Gate 1, or what should change?'. No changes to src/ or package.json yet.
